summary: macOS local peer attribution now walks proc_pidinfo ancestry and KERN_PROCARGS2 environments with nearest-process masking and before/after process-birth validation. A successful walk without a harness remains a person; failed inspection cannot grant person authority.

compatibility.detail: No wire shape change. Failed local peer inspection denies backup/proof exports, internal routes, LOCAL_PERSON_HEADER sessions and actor/requester body impersonation, rather than all public traffic. macOS has no pidfd: before/after birth-time checks narrow but cannot eliminate the PID reuse window. Cooperative ancestry is not an isolated scratch launcher credential.

downtime.detail: Takes effect after daemon restart with the new build.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit and restart the daemon.
